profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Accenture Federal Services - Learner | Restorative
profile.summary:
I design and deliver technology based solutions that provide efficiences to existing processes and create viable solutions to business problems.

Specialties: Software systems architectures, model driven development, custom software development

positions.title: Accenture Federal Services Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading a team of developers and operation administrators that manage and develop Salesforce applications for multiple business functional teams like sales, HR, and finance.

positions.title: Enterprise Reporting & Analytics Manager
positions.description: Managed a team of developers responsible for creating enterprise reports in Cognos and analytic dashboards in Qlik. Built strong customer relationships with clients to bring best in class financial reporting to support critical systems for the business.

positions.title: Financial Systems Integration Developer
positions.description: Supported finance reporting systems using VBA and Excel. Built interfaces between finance systems to support integration between financial systems and companies.

positions.title: Software Developer Accenture Delivery Tools
positions.description: Multiple disciplinary development role where I built custom Java extensions used for creating estimation models, wrote white papers on software development methods like agile. Obtained scrum master certification. Designed packaged software components to support the development lifecycle. Create Cognos reporting templates for project teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Eclipse · Agile Methodologies · ClearQuest · Model Driven Development · Java · ClearCase · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Software Developer Accenture Delivery Methods
positions.description: Developed custom software application used to build custom web sites for learning team. Developed in DotNet using asp and javascript to provide an interactive site for creating content.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · SQL · XML Schema · JavaScript · HTML

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description: Administrated mixed network environment of 1000+ nodes. Responsible for software upgrades, regular maintenance tasks, and other projects requested by stakeholders.

projects.title: Accenture Delivery Tools - Rational Jazz Products
projects.description:
Currently architecting solutions on Rational Team Concert and Collaborative Lifecycle Management applications.

Driving the reporting solutions for Accenture Delivery Tools through the Rational Insight / Cognos system.

projects.title: Masters of Computer Science
projects.description: Completed 33% of a masters degree in computer science at DePaul University, Chicago, IL in 1998/1999. Course work included Operating Systems, C++, Statistics, Discrete Mathematics. Maintained a 3.75 GPA before ending due to life circumstances.
